```powershell
Write-Output '=== FIX 509 - THE ATTACH BUTTON LEARNS THE LAST GAME WINDOW (Ground: his words - the button does not work, nothing attaches, therefore no godmode. The source read shows why, exactly: the attach reads whichever window stands in front at the moment of the click, and clicking the button puts the terminal itself in front, so the attach only ever sees the terminal, speaks its one line, and returns. The game never had a road in. This job censuses the attach callers and every foreground read in the source, then applies the branch the shapes allow: if a standing watcher already reads the foreground on its own tick, the job teaches the terminal to remember the last non-terminal window it saw and the attach takes that window when the click lands on the terminal itself; if no watcher stands, the button instead starts a three second window and speaks Now click your game, so the click lands on the game first and the attach reads the game. On a clean patch the job closes the running terminal, compiles with the standing compiler line, relaunches the fixed build, and prints its log tail. Every variable carries the p509 prefix.) ==='
$p509b64 = ''
$p509py = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'patch509.py'
[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($p509py, [Convert]::FromBase64String($p509b64))
$p509exe = 'C:\Users\Admin\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WindowsApps\python.exe'
$p509out = & $p509exe $p509py
$p509out | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_ }
$p509dir = 'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal'
$p509bin = Join-Path $p509dir 'PhiTerminal.exe'
if (($p509out -join ' ') -match 'PATCH OK') {
  Get-Process -Name 'PhiTerminal' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force
  Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
  $p509csc = 'C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe'
  $p509cs = Join-Path $p509dir 'PhiTerminal3.cs'
  $p509cout = & $p509csc /target:winexe /out:$p509bin /reference:System.Windows.Forms.dll /reference:System.Drawing.dll $p509cs 2>&1
  $p509cout | Select-Object -Last 6 | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('CSC ' + $_) }
  Write-Output ('EXE bytes=' + (Get-Item $p509bin).Length + ' written=' + (Get-Item $p509bin).LastWriteTime)
  Start-Process -FilePath $p509bin -WorkingDirectory $p509dir
  Start-Sleep -Seconds 4
  $p509log = Join-Path $p509dir 'phi_terminal_universal.log'
  if (Test-Path $p509log) { Get-Content $p509log -Tail 6 | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('NEWTAIL ' + $_) } }
  Write-Output 'PHI P509 VERDICT: ATTACH FIXED BUILD STANDING'
} else {
  Write-Output 'PHI P509 VERDICT: PATCH HELD - PRINTS ABOVE'
}
Write-Output 'JOB 509 DONE'
```
